subject: MAP: procurement runway & signature cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@ambletech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP: procurement runway & signature cadence

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the MAP draft and the procurement runway. Attaching MAP_draft_v1.xlsx for reference.

Call highlights / proposed milestones (high level):
- 1) Finalize SOW draft — Redwood (Marissa) deliverable, target: 2027-06-18
- 2) Security questionnaire & evidence — AmbleTech to confirm questions; Redwood to provide answers by 2027-06-25
- 3) Technical validation (PoC / perf validation) — joint sessions, target completion: 2027-07-05
- 4) PO & procurement paperwork — AmbleTech procurement to raise PO by 2027-07-12
- 5) Contract review & signature — target procurement/contract signature deadline: 2027-07-21
- 6) Target close / kickoff: 2027-07-29 (tentative; can move earlier if signatures complete sooner)

Dependencies we discussed: legal redlines turnaround (typically 3 business days), procurement lead time for PO approvals, and security evidence for our Private deployment option.

As requested on the call, please confirm: (a) the internal stakeholders who will sign or escalate procurement decisions; (b) whether procurement has any blackout dates in July; and (c) whether the PO path requires any additional finance approvals. If procurement is aiming for an earlier signature, we can accelerate the SOW and legal pass to meet that date.

Next steps (my ask):
- Priya / Raj: confirm procurement target signature date and PO owner by end of this week
- Marissa: circulate SOW outline (attached) and incorporate pricing details
- Ben: set up recurring 30-min checkpoints starting the week of 6/21

I’ll hold a short follow-up on Thursday to capture any changes and lock the MAP milestones.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

From: Priya Rao <priya@ambletech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Kapoor <raj@ambletech.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MAP: procurement runway & signature cadence

Hannah — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Procurement preference is to have an executed contract and PO in place by 2027-07-21. That is our target if the SOW and pricing are final by mid-July.
- I attached our procurement_requirements.pdf which lists standard attachments (W-9, certs) and our vendor onboarding questions — legal will prioritize a 48–72 hour review once we have a final SOW.
- Our PO owner is Raj (cc’d). We do have a finance committee meeting on 7/26 that could delay approvals if paperwork isn’t ready before that date.

If Redwood can confirm the SOW and send the final pricing worksheet by 6/18, we should be able to stick to 7/21. Also: can you confirm whether the Private deployment option requires additional compliance attestation? That will affect our security timeline.

On the MAP itself: we’d like responsibilities listed explicitly (who owns each deliverable). Can Ben/Marissa update the draft to show owners and expected deliverable dates?

Thanks — Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Product, AmbleTech
priya@ambletech.com
Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf

If that looks good, Marissa will drop final pricing into the SOW and we’ll circulate for legal review.

Revised milestones & owners (proposed):
- 2027-06-18: Redwood sends final SOW draft (owner: Marissa Cole, Redwood) — attachment: SOW_outline.docx
- 2027-06-25: Redwood delivers completed security questionnaire + evidence links (owner: Soojin Lee, Redwood)
- 2027-07-05: Joint tech validation sessions complete (owner: AmbleTech / Priya to coordinate schedules)
- 2027-07-12: AmbleTech raises PO (owner: Raj Kapoor, AmbleTech procurement)
- 2027-07-14: Legal redlines back to Redwood (owner: AmbleTech legal) — target 2–3 business day turnaround
- 2027-07-21: Contract fully executed (owner: AmbleTech + Redwood signatories)

Operational notes:
- We will prepare a DocuSign envelope and link once legal confirms the final SOW. Link placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/REDW-4821
- HubSpot deal ID: 4821 (internal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821)
- Weekly cadence: 30-min checkpoints each Tuesday starting 2027-06-22 to keep the MAP on track.

Let us know today if any of these target dates are blockers for procurement. If AmbleTech can commit to 7/21 signature, we’ll prioritize the SOW and security evidence over the next two weeks.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
